question: The climatic conditions of thorn forests and scrubs are the most ideal for which of the following plant species?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Euphorbia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **family Euphorbiaceae **includes the enormous and diverse genus of **flowering plants** known as **Euphorbia.**
 
• These are sometimes known as **spurge.**
 
• All euphorbia has** distinctive flower structures** and a** deadly secretion** that resembles latex.
 
• Together with **Rumex and Senecio,** it also possesses one of the broadest variations of** chromosomal numbers.**
 
• These flowers** lack petals, sepals**, and other components that are common to flowers in other plant species.
 
• In regions with less than **70cm of rainfall,** thorn forests and scrubs are common.
 
• The** typical temperature** ranges from** 25 to 30 degrees Celsius.**
 
• Euphorbia thrives best in the **climatic conditions of thorn forests and scrubs.**​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Trees found in** tropical evergreen forest**s include** cinchona, rosewood, mahogany, and ebony**.
 
• Among the trees found in **tropical deciduous forests** are **oak, beech, birch, beech, maple, and elm.**
 
• **Acacias, euphorbias, palms, and cacti** are among the plants that make up a** tropical thorn and shrub forest.**
 
• Trees from the genuses** Avicenna, Rhizosphere, Ceriops, and Bruguiera **are found in** mangrove forests.**
 
• **Rhododendrons, oak, maple, ferns, juniper, and deoder** are some of the trees found in** montane forests.​ **
